- **Low Poly Chicken** by [Pjager](https://sketchfab.com/Pjager), [source](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/low-poly-chicken-1055e4feaabf43b0a34f3610fccfd8f3), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- **Egg** by [Casca_Servillius](https://sketchfab.com/Casca_Servillius), [source](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/egg-5a9af4a9f9cf4e0d8c7a0728643a27d8), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The original GLB files supplied for this project are included here. `convert_glb.py` bakes the chicken's rest pose and exports both models to OBJ for Unity. The golden egg is a material variant of the Egg model; the imported geometry and chicken texture are unchanged.
